note: One entry per terminology source. status ALLOW only after the license text was read (verified_on + evidence). A source that is not listed behaves as REVIEW_REQUIRED (= private).

sources.name: Project-authored medical vocabulary (medical_vocab/)
sources.evidence: Written for this project from general medical-education knowledge, not scraped or copied from a third-party dataset (medical_vocab/SOURCES.json); the owner of the project is the rights holder.
sources.notes: Generic (INN) drug names are public names, not copyrightable.

sources.name: Synthetic test fixtures (concepts written for the v4 tests and false-positive traps)
sources.evidence: Authored in this repository for tests; contains no third-party data.

sources.name: Synthetic medical-looking terms for scale benchmarks
sources.evidence: Random compositions of Greek/Latin roots; not medical knowledge and not meant for shipping.
sources.notes: Benchmark data only; refused by public builds on purpose.

sources.name: UMLS Metathesaurus (NLM)
sources.license_name: UMLS Metathesaurus License Agreement (UTS account required)
sources.evidence: Access needs an accepted license agreement; many included source vocabularies carry their own restrictions. Treated as private-only; the per-vocabulary categories are not evaluated here.
sources.notes: The importer reads a locally licensed copy and never downloads or bypasses the agreement.

sources.evidence: Page read on 2026-10-13 (last reviewed by NLM 2019-05-21): no charges or royalties; users agree to acknowledge NLM with 'Courtesy of the U.S. National Library of Medicine', not to imply NLM endorsement, and - when redistributing - to maintain the most current version OR state conspicuously that the product does not reflect the most current data.
sources.notes: English descriptor file only (translations and supplementary concept records are not imported).
